evidence.title: Mol-JEPA: A multimodal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Molecules

summary: A new AI architecture, Mol-JEPA, combines multimodal joint embedding techniques to advance molecular prediction tasks. The model aims to improve accuracy in drug discovery and material science by integrating diverse data types.
title: Researchers Introduce Mol-JEPA: A Multimodal AI Model for Molecular Prediction
